advisory.finding: The new fsck SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL detection (_check_snapshot gate) and the _has_retired_create helper have no test coverage — no test constructs a pre-feature SNAPSHOT (compiled_state lacking creation_channel) with a retained .retired CREATE and asserts fsck emits SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, nor that a post-feature snapshot (channel present) or a channel-less snapshot WITHOUT a retained CREATE does NOT trip it.
